Her cataracts, first diagnosed in 2011, are being managed conservatively with no medication prescribed currently.

Regarding her musculoskeletal injury from September 2021, she is taking cyclobenzaprine 10 mg, and her condition is controlled.

Her gout, diagnosed in November 2017, is controlled with colchicine 0.6 mg. She reports no recent flare-ups.

She also has a history of acute sinusitis, diagnosed in August 2019. She is currently on azithromycin 250 mg to manage this condition, and it is also well controlled.

In summary, all of Diane Allen's chronic conditions are under control with her current medication regimen. She reports no new significant issues beyond the rash, which was the reason for her recent visit.
